description.value: A waterfront vacation rental in Dorman Bay on Bowen Island, offering four private suites in a main house plus a separate modern cabin with sweeping ocean views to the north, east, and south. Guests share a wood barrel sauna, hot tub, communal fire pit, lawn games field, and a wooden staircase descending directly to the ocean. Cyclists can reach the property via BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay — bikes are permitted on the ferry — followed by a 15-minute ride from Snug Cove terminal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website was successfully fetched and provides detailed accommodation information. The FAQ explicitly states 'you're welcome to bring your own bike' and mentions bike access to the ferry, but nowhere does the website describe secure bike storage (locked room, shed, or garage). Wi-Fi is confirmed by both OSM (internet_access=wlan) and the website ('All suites and the cabin have access to high speed wi-fi'). The property address on the website (883 Hummingbird Lane, Bowen Island, BC) differs from the OSM community field ('North Vancouver') — Bowen Island is its own separate municipality.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the property is on Bowen Island, BC — a separate municipality. Address on website (883 Hummingbird Lane, Bowen Island, BC) is not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating waterfront vacation rental on Bowen Island with an active website, valid business license, and BC registration number. Useful to touring cyclists arriving by ferry.
enrichment_extras.notes: The FAQ explicitly notes guests may bring bikes but that Bowen Island is very hilly. It also notes eBike rentals are available nearby from Bowen eBikes in Snug Cove. No bike-specific storage described anywhere on the site.
